title: Home practical guide and safety card: torch and materials
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 3 (Home practical guide and safety card: torch and materials (portal worksheet; never shine into eyes))
intro: Lesson 3: Shadows: shape and position. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which materials let light through
equipment: Materials: foil, tissue, clear plastic, card, greaseproof paper
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Hold each material in front of the torch; never shine into eyes
Look at the light on a wall
Make a shadow with an opaque object
Move the torch closer and further and watch the shadow

questions.q: A shadow forms when light is...
Big question: why is your shadow long in the morning?
questions.a: The Sun is low, so the light hits at a low angle and makes a long shadow.
